name: Update Project Cost from Stock Entry
script:
# Update Project total_costing_amount when Stock Entry is submitted
if doc.project:
	# Get total stock value from this entry
	total_value = 0
	for item in doc.items:
		if item.basic_amount:
			total_value += item.basic_amount
	
	if total_value > 0:
		# Update Project
		project = frappe.get_doc("Project", doc.project)
		
		# Add to existing costing amount
		current_cost = project.get("total_costing_amount") or 0
		project.total_costing_amount = current_cost + total_value
		
		# Save without triggering events
		project.flags.ignore_validate_update_after_submit = True
		project.save(ignore_permissions=True)
		
		frappe.msgprint(f"Updated project {doc.project} cost by {total_value}")
